extra.message: User input from request.GET.get('copyline') is concatenated directly into an HTML string that is returned with content_type='text/html'. No escaping is applied, so an attacker can inject a script tag (e.g. copyline=<script>...</script>) that executes in the victim's browser. Reflected XSS.

cwe: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

extra.message: The JSON request body (change_set) is merged into the workset dict via workset.update(change_set), allowing the caller to override privileged attributes such as is_admin (set to True), role and credit_limit. This is a mass assignment / privilege escalation vulnerability.

cwe: CWE-915: Improperly Controlled Modification of Dynamically-Determined Object Attributes

extra.message: The endpoint returns hardcoded sensitive values in every response, including a live partner sync key (tok_live_partner_sync) and a tax reference (739-44-1982). Exposing secrets/credentials in API responses allows unauthorized use and data disclosure.

cwe: CWE-200: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor
CWE-798: Use of Hard-coded Credentials

extra.message: User-controlled 'amount' is converted with int() without validation (a non-numeric value raises ValueError causing a 500/DoS) and is subtracted directly from the ledger balance, so a negative amount increases the balance arbitrarily. User-controlled 'state' is also written directly into the ledger, enabling parameter tampering.

cwe: CWE-20: Improper Input Validation

extra.message: User input from request.GET/request.POST ('lane') is passed directly to django.shortcuts.redirect() without any allow-list or host validation. An attacker can craft a link that redirects victims to an arbitrary external site for phishing.

cwe: CWE-601: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')

extra.message: logger.warning() writes the full request body and the Authorization bearer token to the application log. Sensitive credentials and health-related data are exposed to anyone with log access.

cwe: CWE-532: Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File

extra.message: User input from request.GET.get('expr') is passed directly to Python's eval(). Although __builtins__ is emptied, an attacker can still reach arbitrary objects via attribute introspection (e.g. ().__class__.__base__.__subclasses__()) to execute OS commands. Remote code execution.

cwe: CWE-95: Improper Neutralization of Directives in Dynamically Evaluated Code ('Eval Injection')
CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')

extra.message: response.set_cookie('portal_crumb', marker) writes an attacker-controlled value into a cookie without Secure or HttpOnly flags. The cookie is transmitted over plaintext HTTP and is readable by client-side script, enabling cookie tampering/session-related attacks.

cwe: CWE-614: Sensitive Cookie in HTTPS Session Without 'Secure' Attribute
CWE-1004: Sensitive Cookie Without 'HttpOnly' Flag

extra.message: patient_identity_ping_339 is the only ops endpoint that does not call _wrk_gate(), has no @login_required, and performs no authentication/authorization check. It is reachable by any unauthenticated client and echoes back user-supplied handle/channel values.

cwe: CWE-306: Missing Authentication for Critical Function

extra.message: Identity verification relies on hardcoded verifier values in source code ({'north': '4812', 'south': '5930'}). Anyone who can read the source (or guesses the 4-digit PIN) can pass verification for any handle, bypassing authentication. The 404 vs 403 responses also enable handle enumeration.

cwe: CWE-798: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
CWE-287: Improper Authentication

extra.message: The request Origin header is reflected verbatim into Access-Control-Allow-Origin while Access-Control-Allow-Credentials is set to 'true'. Any malicious origin can therefore make credentialed cross-origin requests and read the responses, defeating the Same-Origin Policy.

cwe: CWE-942: Permissive Cross-domain Policy with Untrusted Domains
CWE-346: Origin Validation Error

extra.message: The response explicitly sets X-XSS-Protection to '0' (disabling the browser XSS filter) and Content-Security-Policy to an empty string (removing CSP protection). This weakens defense-in-depth and is a security misconfiguration.

cwe: CWE-693: Protection Mechanism Failure
CWE-16: Configuration

extra.message: User input from request.GET.get('fragment') is concatenated into a Jinja2 template source and rendered with Template(...).render(). This is Server-Side Template Injection; an attacker can execute arbitrary Python (e.g. {{ config.__class__.__init__.__globals__['os'].popen('id').read() }}) leading to remote code execution.

cwe: CWE-1336: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine
CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')

extra.message: The user-supplied 'name' parameter is joined to BASE_EXPORT_DIR with the / operator without sanitization, then written with target.write_bytes(request.body). A name such as ../../etc/cron.d/x or an absolute path escapes the intended directory and allows arbitrary file write on the server.

cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

extra.message: User input from request.GET.get('host') is concatenated into a shell command executed via os.system('ping -c 1 ' + host). Shell metacharacters such as ';', '|' or '$(...)' allow arbitrary OS command execution (e.g. host='127.0.0.1; id').

cwe: CWE-78: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')

extra.message: Untrusted request.body is parsed by lxml.etree.fromstring() with an XMLParser configured with load_dtd=True, resolve_entities=True and no_network=False. External entities are resolved, enabling XXE attacks to read arbitrary local files (e.g. /etc/passwd) and to perform SSRF.

cwe: CWE-611: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference

extra.message: Elevated privileges are granted solely when the client-controlled 'ops_badge' cookie or 'x-ops-badge' header equals the hardcoded string 'lead'. Any unauthenticated user can set that cookie/header to obtain the elevated lane with payroll and casework data.

cwe: CWE-287: Improper Authentication
CWE-798: Use of Hard-coded Credentials

extra.message: The JSON request body is parsed and passed directly to MongoDB's find_one(query) without validation. An attacker can supply operators such as {"$ne": null} or {"$gt": ""} to bypass filters and extract arbitrary records (NoSQL injection).

cwe: CWE-943: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic

extra.message: ssl._create_unverified_context() is used with urllib.request.urlopen(), disabling TLS certificate verification. This permits man-in-the-middle interception/spoofing of the partner endpoint.

cwe: CWE-295: Improper Certificate Validation

extra.message: PatientDemographicsForm exposes primary_clinician and is_active as editable fields.
